game.name: Hades
game.rules:
1. A video of the run is required.
- Use free programs (such as with OBS) or a streaming service to record your run  
- The video you submit must be setup to be permanent (eg YouTube, Twitch highlights).  Recent Broadcasts on Twitch will auto-delete, so will not be approved
- Timestamp the run if it is a part of a longer video.

2. Use the In Game Timer (turn on "Always Display Timer" through settings). Do not block it, the In Game Timer on the Victory Screen, or the Save Icon with alerts or anything (it's in the top right).  

3. Must show the run in full, including before when the in-game timer starts and the Victory screen at the end. 

4. God Mode is not allowed.

5. Times are always rounded down to the nearest second.  eg "48.92 seconds" is still to be submitted as "48 seconds". In cases where the Victory Screen is different to the In Game Timer, the Victory Screen will take priority.

6. Must be played on latest live version of Hades available at the time.

7. The only mod allowed in Unmodded runs is the Colorblind Mod available on the Resources tab, with the condition that SpeedrunMode is enabled in the config (which it is by default). Information on how to install the mod is available in the Guides tab. The Speedrunning Modpack also available on the Resources tab may only be used for Modded subcategories. No other mods are allowed at this point, for any category.

8. Macros and Turbo bindings are banned. You may use 3rd party tools to bind multiple buttons to a single action, but you may not bind a single button to multiple actions.

9. Runs on emulators will not be valid. Wine and Proton are compatibility layers, rather than emulators, so Linux runs will still be valid.

________________________________________________
10. The Codex cannot be opened while the In-Game Timer is running. This is to prevent an exploit we refer to as "Codex-tech".
*You can still open the Codex to check boons and pre-requisites while in the boon selection screen, or in chambers where the timer is completely stopped (such as story chambers like Sisyphus, Eurydice, Patroclus).*

11. You may not use the fishing in lava exploit to indefinitely pause the in-game timer.

categories.name: Any Heat
categories.rules:
## **Any Heat Rules**

1. Achieve Victory using any amount of heat (0 or more).  

2. Must be a single, continuous run. 
No game quit-outs (Alt-F4s, give-ups, quits or crashes) mid-run.

3. Any Mirror, Weapon/Aspect or starting Keepsake can be used. 
You are encouraged to unlock all of these, but it is not necessary.

_______________________________________
Leaderboards are ordered by fastest In Game Time (IGT). 
Real Time is not *required* for this category, but the leaderboard can be sorted by Real Time. 
Your Real Time Attack (RTA) starts as soon as you can move after dropping out of the window at the start of the escape. RTA ends the instant the final boss dies.
_______________________________________

categories.name: Fresh File
categories.rules:
## **Fresh File Rules**

1. Achieve Victory starting from a new game file. 

2. Must be a single continuous series of runs.  
Deaths are allowed, but no quit-outs (Alt-F4s, give-ups, quits or crashes) mid-run.

_______________________________________
*In Game Time (IGT) is not relevant, leave this blank when submitting.*

Time starts as soon as you open the new file, and ends the instant the final boss dies. 
_______________________________________

categories.name: FFTC
categories.rules:
## **Fresh File To Credits (FFTC) Rules**


1. Reach Credits starting from a new game file.

2. Must be a single continuous series of runs.

3. Deaths are allowed, but no quit-outs (Alt-F4s, give-ups, quits or crashes) mid-run.

4. This category allows 50 minutes worth of breaks. Breaks must be taken in the House of Hades, and the game must remain paused for the duration of your break. All breaks must be reported with timestamps in the description of the submission, or they will not be counted.

_______________________________________
*In Game Time (IGT) is not relevant, leave this blank when submitting.*

Time starts as soon as you open the new file, and ends the instant you interact with Persephone after the 10th clear.
_______________________________________

categories.name: OwO
categories.rules:
## **One Weapon Only (OwO) Rules**

1.  Achieve a series of 4 victories, with each victory using a different aspect of the same weapon. Aspects can be used in any order.
    
2.  Must be a single and continuous series of runs. No quit-outs (Alt-F4s, give-ups, quits or crashes) mid-run.
    
3.  Show the previous run's death (or a run completion with the death) at the start of the video.
    
4.  Time starts as soon as you can move after falling out of the window, and ends the instant the final boss of the last aspect run dies.
    
5.  Any Mirror, Weapon, or starting Keepsake can be used. You are encouraged to unlock all of these, but it is not necessary.

6. This category allows 20 minutes worth of breaks. Breaks must be taken in the House of Hades, and the game must remain paused for the duration of your break. All breaks must be reported with timestamps in the description of the submission, or they will not be counted.

_______________________________________
*In Game Time (IGT) is not relevant, leave this blank when submitting.*
_______________________________________

values.name: Modded
values.rules:
## **Modded Rules**

- Must be played on the "Hades Speedrunning Modpack" available in the Resources tab

- Must use a "Leaderboard" ruleset. 
For Multirun Leaderboard Ruleset, the icons in the top right should be Ares, Zeus, Dionysus, Poseidon, and Sisyphus.
For Single Run Leaderboard Ruleset, the icons in the top right should be Ares, Zeus, Dionysus, Poseidon, and Persephone.

- The ruleset hash and modpack version must be fully visible.

- Colorblind Settings and Quick Restart are both disabled by default, but are leaderboard legal. They can be enabled in the "Configure Mods" menu, accessible via the boon screen when in the Courtyard. **Quick Reset cannot be used to return to the House during an attempt.**

- Intentional exploitations of bugs known to be in the Speedrunning Modpack are not allowed. Currently this includes the "Mirror Bug".

categories.name: Any Heat
categories.rules:
## **Any Heat Rules**

1. Achieve Victory using any amount of heat (0 or more).  

2. Must be a single, continuous run. 
No game quit-outs (Alt-F4s, give-ups, quits or crashes) mid-run.

3. Any Mirror, Weapon/Aspect or starting Keepsake can be used. 
You are encouraged to unlock all of these, but it is not necessary.

_______________________________________
Leaderboards are ordered by fastest In Game Time (IGT). 
Real Time is not *required* for this category, but the leaderboard can be sorted by Real Time. 
Your Real Time Attack (RTA) starts as soon as you can move after dropping out of the window at the start of the escape. RTA ends the instant the final boss dies.
_______________________________________

categories.name: Fresh File
categories.rules:
## **Fresh File Rules**

1. Achieve Victory starting from a new game file. 

2. Must be a single continuous series of runs.  
Deaths are allowed, but no quit-outs (Alt-F4s, give-ups, quits or crashes) mid-run.

_______________________________________
*In Game Time (IGT) is not relevant, leave this blank when submitting.*

Time starts as soon as you open the new file, and ends the instant the final boss dies. 
_______________________________________

categories.name: 40 Heat
categories.rules:
## **40 Heat Rules**

1. Achieve Victory using 40 heat or more.  

2. Must be a single, continuous run. 
No quit-outs (Alt-F4s, give-ups, quits or crashes) mid-run.

3. Any Mirror, Weapon/Aspect or starting Keepsake can be used. 
You are encouraged to unlock all of these, but it is not necessary.

_______________________________________
Leaderboards are ordered by fastest In Game Time (IGT). 
Real Time is not *required* for this category, but the leaderboard can be sorted by Real Time. 
Your Real Time Attack (RTA) starts as soon as you can move after dropping out of the window at the start of the escape. RTA ends the instant the final boss dies.

Runs between 40-49 heat can be submitted.
_______________________________________

games.name: Hades
games.rules:
1. A video of the run is required.
- Use free programs (such as with OBS) or a streaming service to record your run  
- The video you submit must be setup to be permanent (eg YouTube, Twitch highlights).  Recent Broadcasts on Twitch will auto-delete, so will not be approved
- Timestamp the run if it is a part of a longer video.

2. Use the In Game Timer (turn on "Always Display Timer" through settings). Do not block it, the In Game Timer on the Victory Screen, or the Save Icon with alerts or anything (it's in the top right).  

3. Must show the run in full, including before when the in-game timer starts and the Victory screen at the end. 

4. God Mode is not allowed.

5. Times are always rounded down to the nearest second.  eg "48.92 seconds" is still to be submitted as "48 seconds". In cases where the Victory Screen is different to the In Game Timer, the Victory Screen will take priority.

6. Must be played on latest live version of Hades available at the time.

7. The only mod allowed in Unmodded runs is the Colorblind Mod available on the Resources tab, with the condition that SpeedrunMode is enabled in the config (which it is by default). Information on how to install the mod is available in the Guides tab. The Speedrunning Modpack also available on the Resources tab may only be used for Modded subcategories. No other mods are allowed at this point, for any category.

8. Macros and Turbo bindings are banned. You may use 3rd party tools to bind multiple buttons to a single action, but you may not bind a single button to multiple actions.

9. Runs on emulators will not be valid. Wine and Proton are compatibility layers, rather than emulators, so Linux runs will still be valid.

________________________________________________
10. The Codex cannot be opened while the In-Game Timer is running. This is to prevent an exploit we refer to as "Codex-tech".
*You can still open the Codex to check boons and pre-requisites while in the boon selection screen, or in chambers where the timer is completely stopped (such as story chambers like Sisyphus, Eurydice, Patroclus).*

11. You may not use the fishing in lava exploit to indefinitely pause the in-game timer.

values.name: Modded
values.rules:
## **Modded Rules**

- Must be played on the "Hades Speedrunning Modpack" available in the Resources tab

- Must use a "Leaderboard" ruleset. 
For Multirun Leaderboard Ruleset, the icons in the top right should be Ares, Zeus, Dionysus, Poseidon, and Sisyphus.
For Single Run Leaderboard Ruleset, the icons in the top right should be Ares, Zeus, Dionysus, Poseidon, and Persephone.

- The ruleset hash and modpack version must be fully visible.

- Colorblind Settings and Quick Restart are both disabled by default, but are leaderboard legal. They can be enabled in the "Configure Mods" menu, accessible via the boon screen when in the Courtyard. **Quick Reset cannot be used to return to the House during an attempt.**

- Intentional exploitations of bugs known to be in the Speedrunning Modpack are not allowed. Currently this includes the "Mirror Bug".
